rows.en: <operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>Mere moments ago, <book(12)>Neo Zeon<endbook()> and the former <book(18)>Giganos<endbook()> army rose up in arms and attacked.
rows.notes: "mere moments ago" avoids mid-sentence "just"; Neo Zeon / Giganos locked (encyclopedia_022).

rows.en: <operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>The attack is at <book(15)>Lhasa<endbook()>.<thumbnail(206)> They are going straight for <book(9)>Federation<endbook()> HQ!
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>Between us and <book(12)>Neo Zeon<endbook()>, small but seemingly elite, there is an overwhelming difference in strength.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>On top of that, with the <book(33)>Macross<endbook()><thumbnail(207)>, our trump card, on hand, the top brass did not take the matter so seriously.
rows.notes: "top brass" matches dialogue_02055 precedent for joutoubu.

rows.en: <operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>But they are far from incompetent. Fully aware their forces are outmatched, they have adopted effective strategies.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>Surprise attacks, allied operations... The fault of the top brass who underestimated them. What a sorry state of affairs.
rows.notes: "kyoutou sakusen" (joint operations) rendered "allied operations" to avoid the lowercase j in "joint".

rows.en: <operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>In any case, I want you to head to the site at once<thumbnail(208)> and take up the defense.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>For the sake of what is to come for us, we must never let them have their way here!
